summary: Frontend UI verification of actors-RLS-scoping change + Send currency-label fix. All 3 roles tested (Admin, Member, Field Officer) across Actors list, Add Connection dialog, Contract wizard supplier picker, Send destination picker, and Send transaction detail page. All core requirements verified passing.

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing bug (NOT introduced this session, NOT in scope of this fix): the 'Actor type' field renders `tx.actors?.country` (shows 'Nigeria') instead of `tx.actors?.actor_type` (should show e.g. 'Aggregator'). Line ~212. The Received section correctly shows counterpart info. Flagging for main agent since it was visible while validating the Currency-label fix that lives 3 lines below it.

action_items: Optional: fix TransactionDetail Send-section 'Actor type' field which currently displays country (tx.actors?.country) instead of tx.actors?.actor_type — pre-existing, not part of this session's change, but noticed during verification.
critical_code_review_comments: useActors hook still applies a client-side connectedOnly filter that excludes self by querying `connections` and building a not-including-self list. Now that RLS on `actors` already restricts to self + connected, the client-side filter is redundant AND has a subtle side-effect: when Member/Field Officer TOGGLE OFF 'Show connected only', self reappears (1 extra row). The review request said 'unchecking should NOT reveal any additional actors' — currently it reveals exactly one (the acting-actor themselves). Not a functional/security issue (RLS still enforces the true scope) but the checkbox is no longer a true no-op for non-Admin. Consider hiding the checkbox for non-Admin or removing the client-side connectedOnly branch entirely.

Otherwise the browse_actor_directory RPC wiring in ConnectionFormDialog, ContractWizard, and SendStockForm is clean and consistent (all 3 call useActorDirectory, all 3 render all 8 actors for Member as verified in-app).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on RLS + directory + currency-label requirements; 1 pre-existing out-of-scope P2 UI bug noted

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 3 accounts logged in successfully
